title: ChangeEmail
description: The body of a request to begin adding an email address to the caller's own account, derived from identity_application::accounts::ChangeEmail. It is a request to START a change, not a completed one: the address is not on the account when this returns.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; ChangeEmailCommand has no body and no route serves it

email_address.description: The address to add. A malformed address, or one already on the account, is a domain refusal rather than a 400 invented here.

make_primary.description: Set the newly VERIFIED address as the account's sign-in address. The flag is honoured only after the address is verified; requesting this for an address that never becomes verified changes nothing, by design.

x-no-actor-field.rule: this body carries no actor, no actor_session_id, and no user_id
x-no-actor-field.why: that absence is what makes self-service mechanical rather than a convention: there is nowhere to put 'as whom'. If a field like actor_id appears here, the command has become an administrative one and belongs in identity_application::administration.
x-no-actor-field.test: identity_application::accounts::tests::no_account_command_carries_an_actor asserts the serialised body contains none of actor_id, actor, as_user, admin

x-phase: Phase 5 — Applications, grants, and the self-service surface
